a2ui.coveredElsewhere: mobile/test/features/chat/a2ui_surface_test.dart — 2 tests PASS: 'A2UI v0.9 JSONL renders data bindings and dispatches actions' and 'unknown A2UI catalog components fail closed'. Rendering and action dispatch are verified at the widget layer; only the end-to-end device observation is missing.
a2ui.structuralFinding: A2UI cannot be device-certified on this build for a STRUCTURAL reason, not a flaky one. An A2UI surface has never appeared in ANY device dump in this suite. The only local tool registered is knowme_diagnostics__local_runtime_status, which emits no artifact, and promote_a2ui_component (chat.rs:613-616) is driven BY an interaction — so nothing on this build produces an A2UI artifact to interact with. Certifying it needs an artifact producer (an agent or skill that emits one), not a louder prompt or a longer timeout.
a2ui.verdict: UNVERIFIED — the model did not emit an A2UI artifact this run
a2ui.whyConditional: A 4B local model is nondeterministic about emitting an A2UI artifact — measured in this suite, the same prompt produced 1 tool call on one run and 0 on the next. Demanding one would make this gate flaky, and a flaky gate teaches people to ignore failures.

harnessDefectFound.defect: the offline toggle could leave com.android.settings/.SubSettings in the foreground
harnessDefectFound.fix: cert_enter_offline detects a settings foreground after the toggle and sends HOME
harnessDefectFound.intermittent: yes — which is why some runs passed and others did not
harnessDefectFound.symptom: a gate typed its prompt into Settings instead of the app and reported 'timed out waiting for generation' with ZERO engine lines — a failure that reads as a broken model but is a stolen window
harnessDefectFound.verified: 4/4 gates PASS after the fix (cancellation, second-send, agents/a2ui, restart-recovery)

offline.method: svc wifi disable + svc data disable, then a reachability probe
offline.why: svc wifi disable ALONE does not take this device offline: measured with wifi_on=0, ping 8.8.8.8 returned 0% packet loss over mobile data, so a flag-only gate would certify nothing.

seededAgents.claim: the built-in agents are present and selectable with NO network
seededAgents.notAcceptedAsProof: the agent-context control alone — it renders whether or not any agent was seeded, so passing on it would certify nothing
